Kahlil Gibran, The Prophet.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/kahlil-gibran/the-prophet

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Kahlil Gibran, the author, died 1931 (Wikidata Q47737, P570 = 1931-04-10 and 1931-00-00; both dates are in 1931).

First publication of the text used: 1923 (SE colophon: 'The Prophet was published in 1923 by Kahlil Gibran.'). The country of first publication is not stated in the facts.

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1923, before 1931, so the United States public domain applies to it.
- Country of origin: the only person whose words are in the text, Kahlil Gibran, died in 1931. The facts name no country of first publication, and the English text's possible countries (the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa) each have a term of life + 70 years or less. Since the last death was in 1931, the text is public domain in each of them since 2002.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook. The creators of, and contributors to, this ebook dedicate their contributions to the worldwide public domain via the terms in the [CC0 1.0 Universal Public Domain Dedication](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)."
